name: mailroom.dispatch
title: Dispatch internal memo
description: Dispatches a single-target internal memo to one room/persona and returns a required response. Internal only. Does not change active room. Subject is auto-generated server-side.

body.description: Memo content/instruction. Must be sufficiently specific for a complete response.

explicit_persona.description: Optional explicit persona invocation within the destination room. If omitted, destination room uses its default persona.

constraints: from_room is auto-detected from server-side active_room; user cannot override
subject is auto-generated server-side; user cannot provide subject
single target only; multiple targets must be rejected by server
response must not ask questions or request uploads/clarification interactively
if insufficient detail, return hard refusal with missing elements; no analysis
conditional closure appended only for substantive/advisory responses
